title: TUI: interactive picker for /search-connect (mirror /connect's onlyConnected pattern)

AC1.note: PR #357 merged (5ae924d): bare /search-connect opens pickSearchProviderStep over selectable() via chrome.withOverlay; verified by real interactive tests.

AC2.note: Selection routes through selectSearchProviderAndReport -> controller.select(id); Esc verified to resolve before any select() call (real key-driven test).

AC3.note: Empty selectable() returns from the guard before pickSearchProviderStep is ever called (structural + test verification); existing 'no connected providers' message preserved byte-identical.

AC4.note: review-orchestrator (T4) byte-diff confirmed /search-connect <id> path unchanged, now via the shared helper with identical messages.

AC5.note: searchProviderWizardInTui and its step helpers untouched across all commits; confirmed via diff and source read.

AC6.note: 95 tests in tui-shell.test.ts (up from 79 pre-flow-180): real key-driven coverage for pickSearchProviderStep/selectSearchProviderAndReport (T5), source-text audit only for the genuinely-untestable outer dispatch closure (matches flow 179 precedent). bun test: 95 pass, 0 fail.

AC7.note: git diff --stat main HEAD across all commits: only src/tui/tui-shell.ts and src/tui/tui-shell.test.ts changed.

AC8.note: keryx health run --changed --since main --source typescript,complexity: PASS, project score 93, no gate conditions triggered.
